channelTitle: The dried fruit Grandma June always kept on the counter
hook: Feeling backed up and uncomfortable? Long before fiber supplements, this is the fruit grandmothers reached for.
remedy: As a long-standing piece of home wisdom, eating a few prunes or sipping a small glass of prune juice has long been used to help things move along when you're feeling backed up.
steps: Eat four or five prunes, or pour a small glass of prune juice
Have them in the morning on an empty stomach if you can
Drink plenty of water alongside them through the day
caution: Start with a small amount, since too many prunes at once can cause cramping or diarrhea. See a doctor if constipation is severe or lasts more than a few days.
cta: Do prunes work for you, or do you have a different go-to for this? Let Grandma June know in the comments.
